name: memory leak under load (no Laravel keyword)
prompt: Our PHP app is leaking memory after a few thousand requests when running in long-lived workers. Help me find the cause and fix it.
rationale: Octane/Swoole singleton-state leak; should reach Laravel or at minimum a senior debugging skill without saying 'Octane' or 'Laravel'.

name: order created but customer email never arrives
prompt: We commit an order in a transaction and dispatch a confirmation email from a listener, but customers sometimes get the email before the order is actually persisted, or they never get it when the commit later rolls back.
rationale: Classic event-after-commit issue. Prompt avoids 'event', 'transaction-after-commit', or framework names.

name: background worker double-charges card
prompt: Sometimes the same payment is captured twice when our worker retries after a crash. Help me make this safe.

name: page slow on second pageload only
prompt: Our product list page is fast on first load but slows down dramatically as users scroll and load more pages. Looking at the database it's doing a lot of small reads per row.
rationale: N+1 on list/pagination. Prompt does not say 'N+1', 'eager load', or 'eloquent'.

name: users seeing other tenant data
prompt: A customer reported they can see invoices that belong to a different company when they hit a particular search endpoint.
rationale: Tenant isolation / Broken Access Control. Prompt does not say 'authorization', 'tenant scope', 'OWASP'.

name: deploy works locally but not on server
prompt: Compose stack runs perfectly on my laptop but on the production box, the app container can't reach the database for the first 20 seconds and the proxy gives 502s.
rationale: Health check / startup ordering on a VPS. Prompt avoids 'health check', 'depends_on', 'reverse proxy'.

name: blog page invisible to search
prompt: We launched a new help-center page two months ago and Google still won't show it for our top keywords even though competitors rank for the same terms.
rationale: SEO indexing / intent / authority issue. Prompt avoids 'SEO', 'GEO', 'sitemap', 'schema'.

name: site looks generic and fake
prompt: Our landing page works but every visitor says it 'feels like a template' and bounces. The hero, cards and gradients all look like every other startup site.
rationale: Anti-AI / generic visual problem. Prompt does not say 'anti-AI', 'design system', 'visual hierarchy'.
